modules.module_title: Design and execute assessment strategy using principles of assessment and Kirkpatrick’s evaluation model

pcs.pc_description: Apply core principles of assessment such as validity, reliability, fairness, authenticity, and flexibility while designing assessments for various learning contexts.
Identify assessment objectives aligned to intended learning outcomes and overall training goals.
Select suitable assessment methods and tools (e.g., quizzes, observations, case studies, practical tasks) that align with the nature and level of competencies being measured.
Design assessment plans that detail the sequence, mode, tools, timing, and performance indicators for evaluating learner achievement.
Explain and apply Kirkpatrick’s Four Levels of Evaluation—Reaction, Learning, Behavior, and Results—to design holistic assessment strategies.
Define indicators and data sources to measure each level of Kirkpatrick’s model, considering training context and organizational needs.
Execute the assessment process according to the defined plan, ensuring adherence to assessment principles and ethical practices.
Collect and analyze feedback and results at all four levels to evaluate assessment impact and effectiveness.
Document findings from Kirkpatrick-level evaluation to inform future instructional design, training effectiveness, and assessment improvements.

modules.module_title: Conduct diagnostic assessment to determine individual training and performance needs

pcs.pc_description: Engage with management and stakeholders to define the purpose, business priorities, and expected individual performance outcomes.
Identify performance indicators and document outcomes in alignment with organizational goals, incorporating stakeholder feedback and approvals.
Evaluate existing resources, constraints, risks, and additional data sources required for conducting diagnostic assessment.
Select suitable diagnostic methodologies, tools, and information sources to evaluate current performance levels.
Develop a detailed project plan including timelines, tools, and templates for conducting the assessment, and revise based on stakeholder feedback.
Communicate the purpose, scope, and methodology of the assessment clearly to the individuals being assessed.
Apply the approved diagnostic process to gather accurate data on skills, knowledge, and attitude gaps.
Analyze the gathered data to identify gaps against the target performance outcomes.
Present preliminary findings to individuals and stakeholders to validate and refine assessment results.
Finalize and prioritize individual training and development needs based on the validated diagnostic findings.

modules.module_title: Design and develop competency-based assessment tools and processes

pcs.pc_description: Apply age- and learner-appropriate principles while designing assessments for different target groups, including children and adults, ensuring alignment with their cognitive, emotional, and developmental needs.

Select and incorporate suitable assessment tools and methods such as portfolios, role plays, observation checklists, and real-world performance tasks to effectively capture competency across learning contexts.
Identify the target candidates, purpose, and context of assessment, considering compliance requirements, candidate needs, and available resources such as budget, location, timelines, and assessors.
Obtain and interpret relevant competencies, occupational standards, and documentation required for designing assessment tools, in consultation with subject matter experts and stakeholders.
Prepare a comprehensive assessment plan detailing the criteria, sequence, tools, resources, roles and responsibilities, documentation, and reporting arrangements.
Share assessment design with competent authorities (e.g., SMEs, clients, assessors) for review, and incorporate valid recommendations to improve design quality.
Review and interpret the finalised assessment plan to identify or update existing tools and ensure alignment with the specified competencies, criteria, and evidence requirements.
Modify or enhance existing assessment tools based on usability analysis and new design specifications.
Select appropriate assessment methods and develop new tools and specific activities that align with the planned evidence requirements and assessment context.
Define clear and inclusive instructions and procedures for assessors and candidates, ensuring appropriate language, accessibility, and clarity for diverse learners.
Address policy and system requirements for assessment tools, including version control, storage, retrieval, and review protocols.
Draft various types of assessment items using sound assessment principles and contextual relevance.
Review and trial the draft assessment tools using defined evaluation criteria to validate their content, usability, and effectiveness.
Gather feedback from relevant stakeholders, analyze trial results, and make final amendments to improve the tools.
Document assessment specifications and format the final tools as per organizational and system policies for proper archiving and future use.

modules.module_title: Evaluate assessment effectiveness and assessor performance to ensure quality and consistency in assessment processes

pcs.pc_description: Establish standard parameters for assessment effectiveness and identify required data sources such as student feedback, assessment results, observations, and audit reports.
Collect and store assessment-related information in compliance with privacy and documentation policies, including any relevant insights beyond the initial evaluation plan.
Analyze collected data to evaluate assessment tools, design, processes, and decisions, and cross- check findings using multiple evaluation sources.
Draw conclusions on assessment effectiveness and document areas of strength and those needing improvement, along with suggested enhancements.
Obtain and share assessor-related occupational standards and performance criteria, clarifying any queries.
Coordinate with administration and assessors to finalize the sample observation schedule and collect assessment timelines.
Conduct observation visits or remote evaluations to review pre-assessments, during- assessment, and post-assessment tasks performed by assessors.
Evaluate assessor performance using defined indicators such as adherence to process, quality of evidence, decision-making, turnaround time, and stakeholder feedback.
Validate field observations with assessors’ post-session and identify individual development needs based on observed performance and collected data.
Document assessor performance evaluations and improvement areas in the prescribed formats.
Select assessment samples for review, ensuring coverage of all assessors, centers, borderline results, and problematic cases.
Independently review assessor decisions and evidence against pre-defined performance standards and assessment rules.
Identify inconsistencies or deviations in decisions, consult with assessors where required, and suggest changes where decisions are found to be incorrect.
Document the evaluation results and recommendations, submit reports within the agreed timelines, and communicate improvement suggestions to stakeholders
